serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Oh man… I ran almost all the way back to my home… 
This Hobo was crazy! God knows what he would do to me if I hadn't dodged him...
I need to stay away from that part of the city…{{wi}} Shit’s crazy out there…
Agh… My lungs are giving out, I’m not really a good runner, never was. 
When I’m back home I gotta take a nice and long nap, I deserve it!
